Name: Yuuji Itadori Modulo NPC
Author: josiejjoestar
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds Itadori Yuuji from Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo to Stardew Valley as a unique character that does not replace any other NPCs. He needs some love and happiness, so come hang out with him! Modulo readers know! I'm really excited about this mod, it's my most ambitious yet. [/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]As another heads up, this Yuuji is from the sequel to Jujutsu Kaisen, JJK Modulo. If you've not read that, I highly recommend it! But dialogue in this mod will include spoilers for both JJK and JJK Modulo, so be aware of that if you play. But knowing the JJK community, there's a good chance you've already been spoiled anyway. [/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]If you're looking for Shibuya incident era Yuji, please check out yujihat's awesome mod here:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23955]Yuji[/url] [/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]With that being said, please proceed with caution through the rest of the mod/description if you're trying to avoid spoilers. [/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8]Yuuji has six heart events, goes to every festival, and has a lot of interesting easter eggs to find. And, just like my Kirara and Megumi mods, he has a tuff beach fit, so get some hardwood for that boat you guys. Also get the movie theater done too while you're at it because he wants to go watch Human Earthworm 67. He definitely needs a friend so be super extra nice to him. His best buds in town are Willy, Harvey, Evelyn, and Penny, but WE ALL LOVE YUUJII ITADORI HE IS THE GOAT![/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8]He also works with the other JJK Stardew mods.  That's why I spelled his name "Yuuji," so he still works with "Yuji" by yujihat! If you want to maximize the Modulo immersion you can um, remove the JJK crew :( But I just keep them in because they are all my specialz. [/color][/font][/size]

[font=Arial][size=3]He is supposed to work with Stardew Valley Expanded. Let me know if you find any issues with this![/size][/font]

[font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[size=3]Install SMAPI:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
Install Content Patcher:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Download Yuuji Itadori Modulo NPC - Stardew Valley here.
Unzip the file and drag the folder into your "Mods" folder 

The link below will help you get started adding mods to Stardew if this is your first one! Feel free to comment with any questions.
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Modding Getting Started Wiki[/url][/size][/color][/font]


[font=Arial][size=4][b]Gift Preferences[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Loved Gifts:[/b][/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]Ruby, Ancient Doll, Strange Doll, Rusty Cog, Puffer Fish, Pizza, Cookies, Melon, Sea Urchin, Strawberry, Cheese, Rabbit's Foot, Fairy Rose, Apple,  Sea Cucumber, Super Cucumber[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Liked Gifts:[/b][/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]Fire Quartz, Joja Cola, Pancakes, Spicy Eel, Sashimi, Maki Roll, Strange Bun, Garlic, Ancient Fruit, Ginger[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8][b]Dislike: [/b][/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8]Cave Carrot, Green Algae, White Algae, Carp Surprise, Pumpkin, Void Egg, Void Mayo, Truffle, Algae Soup, Pale Broth[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8][b]Hates: [/b][/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8]Poppy, Escargot, Slime, Monster Musk[/color][/font][/size]

[font=Arial][size=3]He has unique reactions to a bunch of gifts, so try them all out. Especially Sea Urchins and Sea Cucumbers![/size][/font]

[font=Arial][size=4][b]Schedule[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#d4d4d8][b]Yuuji Starts at the Wizard Tower.[/b][/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][b]Monday:[/b] Leaves home at 700 (7AM) to hang out at the hospital with Harvey. Then, at 1100 (11AM) He goes to hang out by the Mountain Lake. At 1800 (6PM) He heads to the mines, and at 2200 (10PM) he heads home.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Tuesday:[/b] Heads to the hospital at 700 (7AM) to chill with Harvey. Then, at 1100 (11AM), he heads to Pierre's shop to get some snacks, and at 1300 (1PM) he goes to workout with the girlies. At 1600 (4PM) He goes to cook with Evelyn, and at 1900 (7PM) he chills on a bridge in town. At 2200 (10PM) He heads home.[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Wednesday:[/b] Leaves home at 700 (7AM) to go to the graveyard. At 1100 (11AM) he goes and sits at the picnic table above Pierre's.  At 1600 (4PM) he goes cook with Evelyn, and at 1900 (7PM) he goes and chills on a bridge in town, and finally heads home at 2200 (10PM)[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Thursday:[/b] at 800 (8AM) he heads to Pierre's to get some snacks. Then, at 1200 (12PM) He heads to the beach. At 1700 (5PM) He goes to sit by Willy at the Pier. Then, he heads home at 2200 (10PM)[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Friday:[/b] at 700 (7AM) he heads to the museum to help Penny teach the kids. At 1400 (2PM) he stands outside the museum by the river. At 1700 (5PM) He goes to hangout in the Saloon with the townspeople. He heads home at 2200 (10PM)[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Saturday: [/b]Heads into the forest at 800 (8AM) to do some training. Then, at 1800 (6PM) he heads near the entrance of the secret woods to chill for a bit, and finally heads home at 2200 (10PM)[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sunday:[/b] Heads to town at 700 (7AM) to hang out in the graveyard. Then he heads to the forest at 1230 (12:30PM) to do some training. Then, at 1800 (6PM) he goes near the entrance to the secret woods to chill.[/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Rain:[/b] He goes to the beach and is sad :([/color][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8][b]Festival Schedule:[/b] He goes to the trout derby on Summer 20 and 21, and the Night Market on winter 16. He goes to the Desert Festival when it's unlocked. [/color][/font][/size]

[font=Arial][size=4][b]Heart Events[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]2 Heart Event: Town, any sunny day between 1000 and 1800 (10AM and 6PM)[/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]4 Heart Event: Forest, any sunny day between 1100 and 1800 (11AM and 6PM)[/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]6 Heart Event: Beach, any RAINY day between 900 and 2000 (9AM and 8PM)[/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]8 Heart Event: Bus stop, any sunny day between 900 and 1600 (9AM and 4PM)[/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]8 Heart Event Part 2: Town, just follow Yuuji there after 8 heart event part 1. [/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]10 Heart Event: Bus stop, any sunny day between 1300 and 2000 (1PM and 8PM)[/color][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]12 Heart Event: Town, any sunny day between 900 and 1600 (9AM and 4PM)[/color][/font][/size]
